QuestionStmt.S: Calculate the molar mass of an element if it forms fcc unit cell structure. [mass of unit cell = $1.8 \times 10^{-22}$ g, $N_A = 6.022 \times 10^{23}$ mol$^{-1}$]

Solution.S:
In fcc lattice, number of atoms per unit cell = 4.

Mass of unit cell = $1.8 \times 10^{-22}$ g.

Mass of one atom = $\frac{1.8 \times 10^{-22}}{4} = 0.45 \times 10^{-22}$ g.

Molar mass = mass of one atom × Avogadro's number:

$$M = (0.45 \times 10^{-22}) \times (6.022 \times 10^{23})$$

$$= 0.45 \times 6.022 \times 10^{1} = 2.7099 \times 10 = 27.099 \approx 27.0 \text{ g mol}^{-1}$$

Thus the correct option is A.
